signature: SUBROUTINE ZLACRT( N, CX, INCX, CY, INCY, C, S )

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of elements in the vectors `CX` and `CY`.

params.name: x
params.reference: On input, the vector x. On output, `CX` is overwritten with $c \, x + s \, y$.

params.name: incx
params.reference: The increment between successive values of `CX`. `INCX` \<\> 0.

params.name: y
params.reference: On input, the vector y. On output, `CY` is overwritten with $-s \, x + c \, y$.

params.name: incy
params.reference: The increment between successive values of `CY`. `INCY` \<\> 0.

params.name: s
params.reference:
C and S define the matrix

$$
\begin{bmatrix} C & S \\ -S & C \end{bmatrix}
$$
